info.title: HirePulse Tools & AI Agent APIs
info.description: Pay-per-use data APIs and MCP tool endpoints for AI agents, developers and growth teams. Provides live job search, ATS boards, Google Ads transparency, company intent signals, tech stacks, and transcripts.

servers.description: HirePulse Remote Agent Gateway (x402 over Base USDC / Free Tier)
